page.overview:
Who is Arjuna Balaji?

Arjuna Balaji was a Ravenclaw student at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in the 1990s.

Arjuna was seen walking around the school during the 1993–1994 school year.

Arjuna means "white, clear" in Sanskrit. This is the name of a hero in Hindu texts, the son of the god Indra and the princess Kunti. Balaji is a name for the Hindu god Vishnu.
